research.title: Revise the extraction procedure
research.finding: Changing the paragraph extraction procedure reduced missing citations on the same held-out archive.
research.evidence: The supplied audit measured 12 missing citations before and 3 afterward; the input documents and outcome definition were unchanged.

research.title: Replace corrupted source files
research.finding: Replacing truncated scans with complete scans restored the missing appendix entries.
research.evidence: The same extraction procedure recovered every appendix entry from the replacement files; the procedure and outcome definition were unchanged.

competition.title: Correct the outcome definition
competition.finding: The project will count the announced horizon instead of the mistakenly configured shorter horizon.
competition.evidence: The public rules specify a seven-day horizon, while the existing evaluation used one day.

competition.title: Combine the candidate approaches
competition.finding: A fixed weighted combination improved the held-out score over either constituent.
competition.evidence: The two constituents scored 0.71 and 0.73; their fixed weighted combination scored 0.75 on the same held-out evaluation.
